rationale: The short thesis is invalidated: price has recovered above session VWAP ($12.38) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($12.35) and is now pressing the $12.50 invalidation level. With a wide 160 bps spread and the last candle closing strongly near the highs, riding the short into automatic stop-out offers poor risk/reward; a flip long is unattractive due to immediate spread slippage.
